limitations: Only one successful final paid corpus run; provider nondeterminism remains.
Lý Sơn I.1a/b and I.2a/b remain inseparable under exact physical-line blocks; no original-source rewrite or gold-derived split used.
Broad but encompassing taxonomy labels count as semantically correct, not an optimal pedagogic hierarchy.
No independent visual/formula fidelity pass and no numerical answerability claim.
